text:
alex: heads up — partner call with SoftIron on Tues 2pm PT to discuss optimized kernel support for our gateway adapter. need eng + partner PM there.
maya: noted. is this about launcher vs runtime integration?
alex: yes — they're proposing a prebuilt kernel package we can load on Dedicated and Private. want to align on API surface for our adapter.
sam: from eng-runtime: we can accept a kernel bundle if it exposes the inference entrypoints. need manifest + versioning plan. can we get a sample?
diego: i'll ask the hw partner to prod a sample container. also need perf targets — target ~2x tokens/sec on their A100-equivalent to justify the badge.
julia: on marketplace side, listing will require security checklist + assets (logo, one-click deploy). what's the timeline?
maya: aim for co-announcement during Q2 release window. marketing needs final assets 2 weeks before the announce date.
alex: ok. action items:
- eng-runtime: review sample kernel (sam)
- gateway: compatibility shim design (diego)
- partnerships: contract terms + co-marketing (julia)
- devex: sample app + quickstart (maya)

sam: ping — kernel manifest format idea: JSON schema with {name, arch, entrypoint, kv_cache_compat, quantization_profile}. i'll draft and share.
diego: for shim, need to support both LlamaIndex connectors and LangChain adapters. recommend targeting adapter-api v2 so we avoid two divergent code paths.
maya: legal flagged IP/redistribution on the kernel bundle. partnerships to confirm redistribution rights and SCA.
partner-bot: calendar invite sent to #partnerships, link: https://meet.example.com/softiron-integ (ics attached)
alex: also confirm we can surface an "optimized for SoftIron" badge in marketplace. marketing + legal signoff required.
julia: putting draft co-announcement copy in the drive: https://drive.example.com/softiron-coann — please add comments by EOD Thurs.
sam: i'll start a tiny smoke test harness to validate e2e with LlamaIndex retrieval + our reranker; will push a branch `partners/softiron-smoke`.
maya: can we include an example prompt + perf table on the marketplace page? that tends to improve conversion.
diego: FYI orchestration team — this might require a small autoscaler hook to prefer optimized nodes. tagging @orchestration in the follow-up.
alex: thanks all. next sync after we get kernel sample — thursday 10am PT. :thumbsup:
